matchups.recap: Rob got absolutely buttfucked by 7.9 points this week—which is impressive considering how hard he already face-planted on his own. Dude's out here losing to Rinor like it's his job, accumulating Ls faster than his roster accumulates points. At this rate, Rob's gonna need a whole fucking spreadsheet just to track all the ways his season imploded. Better luck next week, chief—though honestly, luck's the only thing that's gonna save this dumpster fire.

Adam's team shit the bed harder than a toddler with diarrhea, limping across the finish line 11 points underwater like a quarterback playing on a broken ankle. With 74.8 points, he managed to assemble what looks like a fantasy roster built by someone whose draft strategy was "close your eyes and point," and it absolutely showed. Flamur came in, counted his chips, and watched Adam's sad little lineup crumble into dust—this wasn't a matchup, it was a goddamn mercy killing. Better luck next week when Adam remembers how to field actual functional players instead of whatever waiver-wire fever dream he's been nursing all season.

Rilind got absolutely obliterated by 62.4 points—that's not a loss, that's a goddamn massacre. You managed to score 70.5 points in what I can only assume was a league where half the teams didn't even show up. Arben didn't just beat you, he beat you so badly that your team might need to file a restraining order. Whatever happened on your roster this week, it wasn't fantasy football—it was a crime scene.

Jetmir and Peter got absolutely skullfucked by 57.7 points—that's not a loss, that's a public execution. Whatever gameplan they thought they had went straight in the trash faster than their waiver wire pickups, and Nori came in swinging a sledgehammer while these two were still figuring out how to turn on the app. This wasn't close, this wasn't competitive, this was a full-on massacre that'll be showing up in highlight reels of what NOT to do in fantasy football.

Ben got absolutely skull-fucked this week, limping across the finish line with 89.6 points like a three-legged dog—and somehow that still wasn't enough to save him from Ilir's completely average 98.4. Eight and a half points is the kind of margin that makes you question every single roster decision you made this season, especially when you're getting outscored by someone who probably started his own backup's backup at wide receiver. Next time maybe don't field a team that looks like it was constructed by a blind monkey throwing darts at a corkboard, Ben.

Veton got absolutely dickslapped by 16.7 points this week, and honestly, it feels generous that he even scored 100—his roster performed like a Practice Squad squad on a Wednesday afternoon. That's what happens when you're still rostering dead weight and can't make a trade to save your life: Faton comes in and reminds you why you shouldn't be running a team with your eyes closed. Better luck next week, chief—you're gonna need a miracle.

matchups.preview: Rob's 0-3 start is looking real cute right now, but let's be honest—this matchup against Flamur's undefeated squad is basically Rob's audition for the waiver wire. Flamur's been running circles around this league while Rob's been out here drafting like he was trying to tank, and now he's about to get absolutely embarrassed on his way to 0-4.

Arben's rolling through like he's actually competent, but let's be honest—he's due for a catastrophic collapse any second now. Rinor's sitting at 2-1 looking for revenge, except his roster's held together with duct tape and false hope, so this is basically Arben's to choke away. Watch him find a creative new way to leave points on the bench while Rinor self-destructs trying to out-choke him.

Nori's riding a two-game win streak like he just figured out how fantasy football works, but we all know he's one bad waiver-wire pickup away from collapsing harder than his decision-making in the draft. Adam's already got his foot in the grave at 1-2, and facing someone who actually remembers to set their lineup is basically a mercy killing—expect him to get absolutely skull-fucked this week.

Ben's clinging to that one win like it's a championship trophy while his roster hemorrhages points every other week—this is the game where Rilind's equally mediocre squad finally takes advantage and puts Ben back on the bench where he belongs. Two teams drowning together, but only one's going down this week, and Ben's got the anchor tied around his ankles.

Veton's got three L's on the board already and is about to make it four against a team that's actually won a game—which is more than we can say for whatever dumpster fire Veton's been running. At 0-3, you've had three chances to not suck and failed spectacularly each time; Jetmir and Peter are coming in hot(ish) with actual wins, so get ready to watch your season get officially pronounced dead.

Faton's sitting pretty at 2-1 but we both know that's just the league letting him hang around before the inevitable collapse—dude's got all the makings of a mid-season implosion. Meanwhile Ilir's been coasting on fumes and luck, and this week the house of cards comes down for one of you clowns; honestly, flip a coin because either way somebody's getting exposed this Sunday.
